intro.text: A street vendor who sells fried potatoes from a cart near central Elendel.

items.text: Dent fries his potatoes to order and serves them in small or large pouches, with sauce if wanted. One busy day Wayne, an old acquaintance, pitched in to serve customers, helping himself to a few potatoes along the way, and Dent watched him talk a customer into "trading" him a wallet.
